senses.gloss: f. (מְלֵי) place for drawing water, well.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21:8">Lev. R. s. 21</cite> <he>ויתיב ליה על מְלוֹיַתְהָן דנשיא</he> sat down by the place where the women draw water; Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 176ᵇ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 571:10">Yalk. Lev. 571</cite> <he>מְלַתְהוֹן</he>; (<cite ref="Ketubot 62b:12">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>אגודא דנהרא</he>).
